metadata.description: Service catalog for AngularJS to Angular migration - identifies cross-cutting services

foundation_critical_services.description: Services that must be migrated in Wave 0 as they are used across multiple screens and form the foundation of the application

services.name: baConfig
services.description: Central theme configuration provider managing colors and theme settings. Used by nearly all chart controllers and theme components.
services.migration_notes: Convert to Angular injectable service with InjectionToken for configuration. Consider using Angular's APP_INITIALIZER for theme setup.

services.name: baSidebarService
services.description: Sidebar navigation service managing menu items and collapse state. Critical for application navigation.
services.migration_notes: Convert to Angular service with BehaviorSubject for reactive state management. Integrate with Angular Router for dynamic menu generation.

services.name: layoutPaths
services.description: Constant defining paths for images and assets used throughout the application.
services.migration_notes: Convert to InjectionToken with environment-based configuration. Consider using Angular's asset handling.

services.name: layoutSizes
services.description: Constant defining responsive breakpoint sizes for sidebar behavior.
services.migration_notes: Convert to InjectionToken. Consider using CSS custom properties or Angular CDK BreakpointObserver.

services.name: colorHelper
services.description: Color manipulation utility functions (tint, shade) used for theme color calculations.
services.migration_notes: Convert to pure utility functions or Angular service. Consider using a color manipulation library.

services.name: themeLayoutSettings
services.description: Service that applies theme classes to body element based on device type and theme settings.
services.migration_notes: Convert to Angular service. Use Renderer2 for DOM manipulation. Consider using Angular CDK Platform for device detection.

services.name: baUtil
services.description: Utility service providing DOM helpers and color conversion functions.
services.migration_notes: Convert to Angular service. Replace jQuery-dependent methods with native DOM or Angular Renderer2.

services.name: preloader
services.description: Service for preloading images and waiting for AmCharts to be ready.
services.migration_notes: Convert to Angular service using Promises/Observables. Consider using APP_INITIALIZER for preloading.

cross_cutting_services.description: Services used across multiple features but not strictly foundation-critical

services.name: baProgressModal
services.description: Factory for displaying progress modal dialogs.
services.migration_notes: Convert to Angular service using Angular Material Dialog or custom modal component.

services.name: fileReader
services.description: Service for reading files as data URLs for upload previews.
services.migration_notes: Convert to Angular service. Use native FileReader API with Observables.

services.name: stopableInterval
services.description: Service for creating intervals that pause when window loses focus.
services.migration_notes: Convert to Angular service using RxJS interval with takeUntil for cleanup.

external_services.description: Third-party services and libraries that need migration strategies

services.name: $uibModal
services.migration_notes: Replace with Angular Material Dialog or ngx-bootstrap modal.

services.name: toastr
services.migration_notes: Replace with ngx-toastr or Angular Material Snackbar.

services.name: editableOptions/editableThemes
services.migration_notes: Replace with Angular-compatible inline editing solution or custom implementation.

http_interceptors.description: HTTP interceptors found in the codebase

route_guards.description: Route guards found in the codebase

stores.name: $rootScope.$pageFinishedLoading
stores.description: Flag indicating page preloading is complete
stores.migration_notes: Convert to BehaviorSubject in a LoadingService

stores.name: $rootScope.$baSidebarService
stores.description: Sidebar service exposed on root scope
stores.migration_notes: Remove - inject service directly where needed

caching_services.description: Caching mechanisms found in the codebase

analytics_services.description: Analytics services found in the codebase
